title: Mandirs of Varanasi
info: An interactive map and spatial analysis of 2,296 street shrines ('tiny temples') surveyed in Varanasi in 2012 and 2015. Shrines are binned into 66-metre hexagons, tested for statistically significant hot spots (Getis-Ord Gi*), measured against the Ganga bank, and explored by deity family and structure.
author: Nathaniel Deaton
